element.name: Future Self Spells
element.description: The power of your future self spirals across time, vitalising your present self with magic. You always have the following spells prepared.

sheet.description: Warlock Level 3: Bless, Calm Emotions, Guidance, Protection from Evil and Good, Spiritual Weapon Warlock Level 5: Clairvoyance, Haste Warlock Level 7: Death Ward, Resilient Sphere Warlock Level 9: Scrying, Telekinesis
